description.fun: Druddigon lives in caves but never skips sunbathing: it warms itself by soaking up sunlight with its wings, and if it gets too cold it can't move at all. Rather than dig its own home, it takes over tunnels made by Pokémon like Diglett and Excadrill. Its red face is harder than rock, so in narrow caves it simply charges head-first. Both of Unova's Champions, Alder and Iris, battle with one.
description.guide: Druddigon is a Dragon-type Pokémon that lives in caves and tunnels dug by other Pokémon. It warms itself with sunlight through its wings and charges with its rock-hard face. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A rock-headed dragon that steals caves and loves sunbathing.
